1.word_for_word: त्रिंशे विरह-सन्तप्त-गोपीभिः कृष्ण-मार्गणम् । — In the thirtieth chapter, the gopīs, tormented by separation, search for Kṛṣṇa.; उनमत्तवन् न नियतं भ्रमन्तीभिर् वने वने ॥*॥ — They wandered from forest to forest like a madman not controlled.; अचक्षाणा अपश्यन्त्यः ॥१॥ — They did not see and did not see.
1.translation: In the thirtieth chapter, the gopīs, tormented by separation, search for Kṛṣṇa. They wandered from forest to forest like a madman not controlled. They did not see and did not see.

2.word_for_word: गत्या च अनुराग-स्मिताभ्यां विभ्रमेक्षितानि स-विलास-निरीक्षणानि, तैश् च मनोरमा आलापाश् च विहाराः क्रीडाश् च विभ्रमाः, अन्ये च विलासाः, तैश् च रमा-पतेर् गत्य्-आदिभिर् एतैर् आक्षिप्तान्य् आकृष्टानि चित्तानि यासां, ताः । — They were the ones whose minds were attracted by the movements and smiles of Rama, who were attracted by these pleasant conversations, plays, games and other pleasures.; अतस् तस्मिन्न् एव आत्मा यासां, तास् तस्य विविधाश् चेष्टा जगृहुः, तद्-अनुकरणेन अक्रीडन् ॥२॥ — Therefore those whose soul was in Him took up His various actions and played in imitation of Him.
2.translation: They were the ones whose minds were attracted by the movements and smiles of Rama, who were attracted by these pleasant conversations, plays, games and other pleasures. Therefore those whose soul was in Him took up His various actions and played in imitation of Him.

3.word_for_word: अपि च गति-स्मितेति । — Also, the movement-smile.; प्रियस्य गत्य्-आदिषु प्रतिरूढा आविष्टा मूर्तयो यासां ताः । — Those whose idols are involved in the movements and other activities of their beloved; अतः कृष्ण-विहार-विभ्रमाः कृष्णस्य एव विहार-विभ्रमाः क्रीडा-विलासा यासां ताः । — Therefore, the illusion of playing with Kṛṣṇa is the illusion of playing with Kṛṣṇa Himself.; अहम् एव कृष्ण इति परस्परं निवेदितवत्यः ॥३॥ — They informed each other that I was Krishna.
3.translation: Also, the movement-smile. Those whose idols are involved in the movements and other activities of their beloved Therefore, the illusion of playing with Kṛṣṇa is the illusion of playing with Kṛṣṇa Himself. They informed each other that I was Krishna.

4.word_for_word: किं च, गायन्त्य इति । — What’s more, they’re singing.; वनाद् वनान्तरं गच्छन्त्यो विचिक्युर् अमृगयन् । — They went from forest to forest, searching for the dead.; उन्मत्त-तुल्यत्वम् आह---वनस्पतीन् पप्रच्छुः । — He argued that they were equivalent to a madman: they asked the plants.; भूतेष्वन्तरं मध्ये सन्तंपुरुषं बहिश् च सन्तम् इति ॥४॥ — The innermost being in the midst of beings is the eternal Person and the eternal outside is the eternal.
4.translation: What’s more, they’re singing. They went from forest to forest, searching for the dead. He argued that they were equivalent to a madman: they asked the plants. The innermost being in the midst of beings is the eternal Person and the eternal outside is the eternal.

5.word_for_word: तत् प्रपञ्चयति नवभिः---तत्र महत्त्वाद् एते पश्येयुर् इत्य् आशयाश्वत्थादीन् पृच्छन्ति---दृष्ट इति । — He argues that by nine: because of the greatness there, they ask Ashvattha and others, hoping that they will see it, and say that they have seen it.; प्रेम-हास-विलसितैर् अवलोकनैर् अस्माकं मनो हृत्वा चोर इव गतो वो युष्माभिः किं दृष्टः ? — What have you seen of you who have taken away our minds with love, laughter and delightful looks and gone like a thief?; इति ॥५॥ — It is said.
5.translation: He argues that by nine: because of the greatness there, they ask Ashvattha and others, hoping that they will see it, and say that they have seen it. What have you seen of you who have taken away our minds with love, laughter and delightful looks and gone like a thief? It is said.

6.word_for_word: महान्तः स्व-पुष्पैर् बहूपकारिणश् चेति कुरवकादीन् पृच्छन्ति---कच्चिद् इति । — They ask the Kuravakas and others if they are great and very useful with their flowers.; हे कुरवकादयः ! — O Kuruvas and others!; दर्प-हरं स्मितं यस्य स इतो गतः कच्चिद् दृष्टः ? — Have you seen him whose pride-destroying smile has gone from here?; इति ॥६॥ — It is said.
6.translation: They ask the Kuravakas and others if they are great and very useful with their flowers. O Kuruvas and others! Have you seen him whose pride-destroying smile has gone from here? It is said.

7.word_for_word: अलि-कुलैःसहत्वा त्वां बिभ्रत्तवातिप्रियस् त्वया किं दृष्टः ? — What have you seen of the wind-loving one who carried you with the Ali-kulas?; इति ॥७॥ — It is said.
7.translation: What have you seen of the wind-loving one who carried you with the Ali-kulas? It is said.

8.word_for_word: गुणातिरेकेऽपि नम्रत्वाद् इमाः पश्येयुर् इति पृच्छन्ति---मालतीति । — Even in the transcendence of virtue, they humbly ask that they should see these things: Malati.; हे मालति, मल्लिके, जाति, यूथिके, वो युष्माभिः किम् अदर्शि दृष्टः ? — O Malati, Mallika, Jati, Euthica, what have you seen in the dark?; कर-स्पर्शेन वः प्रीतिं जनयन् किं यातः ? — What went on pleasing you with the touch of your hands?; इति । — It is.; अत्र मालती-जात्योर् अवान्तर-विशेषो द्रष्टव्यः ॥८॥ — Here the difference between the species of jasmine should be noted.
8.translation: Even in the transcendence of virtue, they humbly ask that they should see these things: Malati. O Malati, Mallika, Jati, Euthica, what have you seen in the dark? What went on pleasing you with the touch of your hands? It is. Here the difference between the species of jasmine should be noted.

9.word_for_word: फलादिभिः सर्व-प्राणिनां सन्तर्पका एते पश्येयुर् इति पृच्छन्ति---चूतेति । — They ask that they should see these who satisfy all living beings with fruits and other things.; चूताम्रयोर् अवान्तर-जाति-भेदः कदम्ब-नीपयोश् च । — There is a difference between the mango and the copper species and between the kadamba and the neepa.; हे चूतादयः, येऽन्ये च परार्थ-भवकाः परार्थम् एव भवो जन्म येषां ते । — O mangoes and others, and all others who are born for the sake of others, you are born for the sake of others.; यमुनोपकूलास् तस्याः कूल-समीपे वर्तमानाः, तीर्थ-वासिन इत्य् अर्थः । — They are on the banks of the Yamuna, meaning those who live near its banks and live in holy places.; ते भवन्तो रहितात्मनां शून्य-चेतसां नः कृष्ण-पदवीं कृष्णस्य मार्गं शंसन्तु कथयन्तु ॥९॥ — Those of you who are devoid of souls and empty-minded, please tell us the path of Kṛṣṇa, the abode of Kṛṣṇa.
9.translation: They ask that they should see these who satisfy all living beings with fruits and other things. There is a difference between the mango and the copper species and between the kadamba and the neepa. O mangoes and others, and all others who are born for the sake of others, you are born for the sake of others. They are on the banks of the Yamuna, meaning those who live near its banks and live in holy places. Those of you who are devoid of souls and empty-minded, please tell us the path of Kṛṣṇa, the abode of Kṛṣṇa.

10.word_for_word: हे क्षिति क्षिते ! — O earth, earth!; त्वया किं तपः कृतं या त्वं केशवाङ्घ्रि-स्पर्शोत्सवा ? — What austerities have you performed that you celebrate the touch of Keshav's feet?; केशवस्याङ्घ्रि-स्पर्शेनोत्सवो यस्याः सा । — She is the one who celebrates the touch of Lord Keśava’s feet.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; अङ्ग-रुहैर् उत्पुलकिता रोमाञ्चिता विभासि शोभसे । — You are shining and beautiful with your hair on your body.; तत्र विशेषं पृच्छति---अपि किम् अयम् उत्सवोऽङ्घ्रि-सम्भवोऽधुना तवैक-देशाङ्घ्रि-स्पर्श-सम्भूतः ? — There he asks in particular: Is this festival, which was born of the feet, now born of the touch of the feet of your one country?; यद् वा, नैतावत् किन्तु उरुक्रम-विक्रमात् पूर्वम् एव त्रिविक्रमस्य पदा सर्वाक्रमणात् । — Or, not so much, but before the Urukrama-vikrama, the foot of the Trivikrama attacked all.; आहो अथवा । — Oh or.; नैतावद् एव, अपि तु ततोऽपि पूर्वं वराहस्य वपुषः परिरम्भणेनेति । — Not only that, but even before that, by embracing the body of the boar.; अतस् त्वया नूनं दृष्टस् तं दर्शयेति ॥१०॥ — Therefore you must have seen him and show him.
10.translation: O earth, earth! What austerities have you performed that you celebrate the touch of Keshav's feet? She is the one who celebrates the touch of Lord Keśava’s feet. Where is it from? You are shining and beautiful with your hair on your body. There he asks in particular: Is this festival, which was born of the feet, now born of the touch of the feet of your one country? Or, not so much, but before the Urukrama-vikrama, the foot of the Trivikrama attacked all. Oh or. Not only that, but even before that, by embracing the body of the boar. Therefore you must have seen him and show him.

11.word_for_word: हरिण्या दृष्टि-प्रत्यासत्त्या कृष्ण-दर्शनं सम्भाव्याहुः---अपीति । — They say that it is possible to see Krishna by the rejection of the deer’s sight.; हे सखि एण-पत्नि ! — O Sakhi En-patni!; अपि किम् उपगतः समीपं गतः ? — Even what has approached and approached?; गात्रैः सुन्दरैर् मुख-बाह्व्-आदिभिः । — They had beautiful bodies, faces, arms and so on.; प्रियया सहेति यद् उक्तं तत्र द्योतकम् । — The statement that he is with his beloved is indicative of this.; कान्ताया अङ्ग-सङ्गः, तेन तत्-कुच-कुङ्कुमेन रञ्जितायाः कुन्द-कुसुम-स्रजो गन्धः । — The attachment of the lover’s body, the fragrance of the garland of kunda flowers painted with the saffron of her breasts.; कुलपतेः श्री-कृष्णस्य । — of the Vice-Chancellor, Sri-Krishna.; वात्य् आगच्छति ॥११॥ — The wind is coming.
11.translation: They say that it is possible to see Krishna by the rejection of the deer’s sight. O Sakhi En-patni! Even what has approached and approached? They had beautiful bodies, faces, arms and so on. The statement that he is with his beloved is indicative of this. The attachment of the lover’s body, the fragrance of the garland of kunda flowers painted with the saffron of her breasts. of the Vice-Chancellor, Sri-Krishna. The wind is coming.

12.word_for_word: फल-भारेण नतांस् तरून् कृष्णं दृष्ट्वा प्रणता इति मत्वा प्रियया सह तस्य गति-विलासं सम्भावयन्त्यः पृच्छन्ति---बाहुम् इति । — Seeing the trees bent down under the weight of fruit, the women think that they are bowing down to Kṛṣṇa and ask Him, thinking that they are enjoying the luxury of His movements with their beloved.; तुलसिकाया अलि-कुलैर् अतस् तद्-आमोद-मदान्धैर् अन्वीयमानोऽनुगम्यमान इह चरन्न् इति ॥१२॥ — He wandered about in this world followed by the young trees of Tulasī trees who were intoxicated with the pleasures of that tree
12.translation: Seeing the trees bent down under the weight of fruit, the women think that they are bowing down to Kṛṣṇa and ask Him, thinking that they are enjoying the luxury of His movements with their beloved. He wandered about in this world followed by the young trees of Tulasī trees who were intoxicated with the pleasures of that tree

13.word_for_word: काश्चिद् आहुः---हे सख्यः ! — Some say, O friends!; इमा लताः कृष्णेन सङ्गता नूनम्, अत इमाः पृच्छत । — These creepers must have been associated with Kṛṣṇa, so ask them.; ननु स्व-पति-सङ्गतौ तत्-सङ्गतिर् दुर्घटा, न । — Indeed, it is difficult to associate with one’s husband, no.; वनस्पतेः पत्युर् बाहुना आश्लिष्टा अपि अहो भाग्यं नूनं तन्-नखैः स्पृष्टा यत उत्पुलकानि बिभ्रति । — Even though she was embraced by the arm of the husband of the tree, oh, how lucky she must have been touched by his nails, which carry the pupils.; न हि स्व-पति-सङ्गताव् ईदृक्-पुलक-सम्भव इति भावः ॥१३॥ — This means that such a pupil is not possible in the company of one’s husband.
13.translation: Some say, O friends! These creepers must have been associated with Kṛṣṇa, so ask them. Indeed, it is difficult to associate with one’s husband, no. Even though she was embraced by the arm of the husband of the tree, oh, how lucky she must have been touched by his nails, which carry the pupils. This means that such a pupil is not possible in the company of one’s husband.

14.word_for_word: उन्मत्तवत् प्रपच्छुर् इत्य् एतत् प्रपञ्चितम् इदानीं---रमा-पतेस् तास् ता विचेष्टा जगृहुस् तदात्मिकाः [भा।पु। — It is now argued that they asked like madmen---they took those movements of Rama-pat and were self-conscious [Bh.p.; १०.३०.२] इति यद् उक्तं तत् प्रपञ्चयति---इतीति । — 10.30.2] explains what has been said.; उन्मत्त-वचो गोप्यः उन्मत्त-वचसश् च ता गोप्यश् च । — They are the gopīs who speak madly and they are the gopīs who speak madly.; कृष्णस्यान्वेषणेन कातरा अतिविह्वलाः । — They were very confused and frightened in their search for Kṛṣṇa.; अनुचक्रुर् अनुकृतवत्यः ॥१४॥ — They followed him and imitated him.
14.translation: It is now argued that they asked like madmen---they took those movements of Rama-pat and were self-conscious [Bh.p. 10.30.2] explains what has been said. They are the gopīs who speak madly and they are the gopīs who speak madly. They were very confused and frightened in their search for Kṛṣṇa. They followed him and imitated him.

15.word_for_word: कस्याश्चिद् इत्य्-आदिभिश् चतुर्भिर् अनुकरणं प्रपञ्च्यते । — The imitation of someone is proposed by four, such as someone else.; ततश् चतुर्भिस् तन्मयत्वं पुनर् एकेनानुकरणम् इति विवेकः । — Then, the discrimination is that the four are the same, and the one is again the imitation.; पूतनायन्त्याः पूतनावद् आचरन्त्याः कृष्णवद् आचरन्ती स्तनम् अपिबत् । — She sucked the breast of Pūtanāyantī, who acted like Pūtanā and acted like Kṛṣṇa.; तोकायित्वा तोकवद् आत्मानं कृत्वा ॥१५॥ — Tokai, making himself like a toka.
15.translation: The imitation of someone is proposed by four, such as someone else. Then, the discrimination is that the four are the same, and the one is again the imitation. She sucked the breast of Pūtanāyantī, who acted like Pūtanā and acted like Kṛṣṇa. Tokai, making himself like a toka.

16-17.word_for_word: दैत्यायित्वा दैत्यवत् तृणावर्तवद् आत्मानं कृत्वा एका कृष्णार्भ-भावनां कृष्णस्यार्भं बाल्यं भावयति या, ताम् अन्यां जहार ॥१६-१७॥ — Having transformed herself into a demon like a demon and like a whirlwind of grass, one woman who thought of the childhood of Krishna as the child of Krishna took away that other (16-17).
16-17.translation: Having transformed herself into a demon like a demon and like a whirlwind of grass, one woman who thought of the childhood of Krishna as the child of Krishna took away that other (16-17).

18.word_for_word: दूरगाः दूरे वर्तमाना गाः । — Cows that go far away are cows that are far away.; यद्वद् यथा कृष्णस् तथा आहूय तं कृष्णम् अनुवर्तमानाम् । — They followed Kṛṣṇa, calling out to Him as they pleased.; \"अनुकुर्वतीम्\" इति वा पाठः ॥१८-१९॥ — or the text \"following\" 18-1
18.translation: Cows that go far away are cows that are far away. They followed Kṛṣṇa, calling out to Him as they pleased. or the text \"following\" 18-1

20.word_for_word: यतन्ती प्रयत्नं कुर्वती अम्बरम् उत्तरीयं वस्त्रम् उन्निदधे ऊर्ध्वं धृतवती ॥२० ॥२१॥ — Trying to do her best she lifted her upper garment and held it up.
20.translation: Trying to do her best she lifted her upper garment and held it up.

22.word_for_word: अपिदध्वं निमीलयत ॥२२॥ — Open up and close it.

23.word_for_word: सुदृक् सुनयनम् आस्यं पिधाय । — Sudrik closed his mouth with his eyes closed.; सुदृक् वराक्षीति वा । — or Sudrk Varakshi.; भीति-विडम्बनं भयानुकरणम् ॥२३॥ — The pretense of fear is the imitation of fear.
23.translation: Sudrik closed his mouth with his eyes closed. or Sudrk Varakshi. The pretense of fear is the imitation of fear.

24.word_for_word: एवं पुनर् अपि वृन्दावने लतास् तरूंश् च कृष्णं पृच्छन्त्यो वनोद्देशे वन-प्रदेशे । — In this way, again, in the Vṛndāvana forest, the creepers and trees in the forest area asked Lord Kṛṣṇa.; व्यचक्षत अपश्यन् ॥२४॥२५॥ — They looked and saw.
24.translation: In this way, again, in the Vṛndāvana forest, the creepers and trees in the forest area asked Lord Kṛṣṇa. They looked and saw.

26.word_for_word: सुपृक्तानि संमिश्राणि ॥२६॥ — They are well-cooked and mixed.

27.word_for_word: तेन अंसे न्यस्तः प्रकोष्ठो यस्याः । — She whose cell is placed on her shoulder by that.; करेणोर् हस्तिन्याः ॥२७॥ — The elephant of the elephant.
27.translation: She whose cell is placed on her shoulder by that. The elephant of the elephant.

28.word_for_word: रह एकान्त-स्थानम् ॥२८॥ — stay in a solitary place.

29.word_for_word: हे आल्यः सख्यः ! — O Alya, my friend!; अहो धन्या अतिपुण्या गोविन्दाङ्घ्र्य्-अब्ज-रेणवः । — Oh, how blessed and most pious are the dust of the lotus feet of Govinda!; तत्र हेतुः---यान् इति । — The reason for this is that they are.; अस्माभिर् अप्य् एतद् रेण्व्-अभिषेकेण तथैव कृष्णः प्राप्तुं शक्य इति भावः॥२९॥ — This means that we too can attain Krishna in the same way by the anointing of Renv.
29.translation: O Alya, my friend! Oh, how blessed and most pious are the dust of the lotus feet of Govinda! The reason for this is that they are. This means that we too can attain Krishna in the same way by the anointing of Renv.

30.word_for_word:
अन्या आहुः---तस्या इति । — Others say that it is hers.; गोपीनां सर्वासाम् । — of all the gopis.; अयं भावः---भवेद् एवं, यदि तस्याः पदानि सम्पृक्तानि न भवेयुः, तानि तु नो दुःखं कुर्वन्ति इति ॥३०॥ — This means that it would be so, if her feet were not touched, but they would cause us pain.; : यदि तस्याः पदानि संपृक्तानि न भवेयुस् तर्हि एवं
कृष्ण-प्राप्ति-साधनं तत्-पद-रजः-सेवनं भवेत् । — If her feet were not touched, then so be it
The means of attaining Kṛṣṇa is to consume the dust of His feet.; तानि नु
संपृक्तानि तत्-पदानि नो दुःखं कुर्वन्ति । — Those are the nu
The steps that are involved make us feel sad.; तस्याः पाद-रजसा
मिश्रितत्वात् कृष्ण-पाद-रजस इति भावः । — By the dust of her feet
Because it is mixed, it means that it is the dust of the black feet.
30.translation:
Others say that it is hers. of all the gopis. This means that it would be so, if her feet were not touched, but they would cause us pain. If her feet were not touched, then so be it
The means of attaining Kṛṣṇa is to consume the dust of His feet. Those are the nu
The steps that are involved make us feel sad. By the dust of her feet
Because it is mixed, it means that it is the dust of the black feet.

31.word_for_word: तद्-असम्पृक्तान् केवलं कृष्ण-पाद-रेणून् एव विचिन्वत्यस् तान् दृष्ट्वा पुनर् अत्यन्तं समतपन् । — They were searching for only the black foot dust that had not been touched by it, and when they saw it, they were again very hot.; तद् आह श्लोक-त्रयेण---न लक्ष्यन्त इति । — He argues that in three verses: they are not noticed.; खिद्यती सुजाते सुकुमारे अङ्घ्रि-तले यस्याः, ताम् उन्निन्ये स्कन्धम् आरोपितवान् ॥३१॥ — He lifted her up and placed her shoulder on the sole of her feet, which was tender and well-born.
31.translation: They were searching for only the black foot dust that had not been touched by it, and when they saw it, they were again very hot. He argues that in three verses: they are not noticed. He lifted her up and placed her shoulder on the sole of her feet, which was tender and well-born.

33.word_for_word: प्रपदाभ्याम् आक्रमणं क्षौणी-मर्दनं ययोः । — They attacked with their feet and crushed the ground.; अत एव असकले पदे पश्यत इति ॥३३॥ — That is why he sees in the incomplete step.
33.translation: They attacked with their feet and crushed the ground. That is why he sees in the incomplete step.

34.word_for_word: तस्याः कृष्ण-जान्व्-अन्तर् उपविष्टायाश् चिह्नं दृष्ट्वाहुः---केश-प्रसाधनम् इति । — They saw the sign of her sitting between her black knees and said that it was a hairdresser.; कान्ताम् अधिकृत्य तानि प्रसूनानि चूडयता चूडानुकारेण बध्नता ध्रुवम् उपविष्टम् ॥३४॥ — Having occupied his beloved he sat down firmly while he was plucking those flowers and tying them in the manner of a braid
34.translation: They saw the sign of her sitting between her black knees and said that it was a hairdresser. Having occupied his beloved he sat down firmly while he was plucking those flowers and tying them in the manner of a braid

35.word_for_word: रेमे इत्य्-आदि शुकोक्तिः । — Reme, etc., is a pity.; आत्म-रतः स्वतस् तुष्टः । — Self-absorbed and self-satisfied.; आत्मारामः स्व-क्रीडः । — Atmaram is his own game.; अखण्डितः स्त्री-विभ्रमैर् अनाकृष्टोऽपि । — Unbroken, though unattracted by the delusions of women.; तथा चेत् किम् इति रेमे ? — If so, what is Reme?; अत आह---कामिनाम् इति ॥३५॥ — Therefore he argues that it is of the lustful.
35.translation: Reme, etc., is a pity. Self-absorbed and self-satisfied. Atmaram is his own game. Unbroken, though unattracted by the delusions of women. If so, what is Reme? Therefore he argues that it is of the lustful.

37.word_for_word: स्त्रीणां दुरात्मताम् आह---सा च इति द्वाभ्याम् । — He argues that women are evil-minded, and she is, in two ways.; कामो यानम् आगमन-साधनं यासां, ता गोपीर् हित्वा मां भजत इति हेतोर् आत्मानं वरिष्ठं मेने इति ॥३६॥ — He considered himself superior to the gopīs for whom lust was the vehicle and the means of their arrival and for this reason they had abandoned Me and worshiped Me.
37.translation: He argues that women are evil-minded, and she is, in two ways. He considered himself superior to the gopīs for whom lust was the vehicle and the means of their arrival and for this reason they had abandoned Me and worshiped Me.

39.word_for_word: कामिनां दैन्यं [भा।पु। — The misery of the lovers [Bh.p.; १०.३०.३५] दर्शयति---एवम् उक्त इति । — 10.30.35] shows that it is said so.; अखण्डितत्वम् आह---ततश् च इति । — He argues that it is unbroken, and then.; तस्यां स्कन्धारोहोद्यतायाम् अन्तर्हित इत्य् अर्थः ॥३९॥ — This means that he disappeared when she was about to climb on his shoulder.
39.translation: The misery of the lovers [Bh.p. 10.30.35] shows that it is said so. He argues that it is unbroken, and then. This means that he disappeared when she was about to climb on his shoulder.

40.word_for_word: अनुतापम् आह---हा नाथ इति ॥३९॥ — He said in repentance, "Alas, my lord.
40.translation: He said in repentance, "Alas, my lord.

41.word_for_word: अन्विच्छन्त्यो मृगयमाणाः । — They were looking for and hunting.; अविदूरतः समीपे ॥४१॥ — Not far from nearby.
41.translation: They were looking for and hunting. Not far from nearby.

43.word_for_word: ततस् तयापि सहिताः कृष्णान्वेषणाय वनम् अविशन् । — Then, along with her, they entered the forest in search of Lord Kṛṣṇa.; ततो अस्यैव हरेर् अन्वेषणान् निवृत्ताः ॥४३॥ — Then they ceased their search for this very Hari.; : गौडीय-टीकाकृद्भिः अत्र अस्यैवेति पठ्यते। — The Gaudiya commentators read it here as this.
43.translation: Then, along with her, they entered the forest in search of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Then they ceased their search for this very Hari. The Gaudiya commentators read it here as this.

44.word_for_word: एवं तम् अप्राप्ता अपि स्व-गृहान् नैव स्मृतवत्यः । — Thus, even though they did not find him, they did not remember their homes.; तद्-आत्मिकाः स एवात्मा यासां ताः, तन्-मय्य इत्य् अर्थः ॥४४॥ — That is the Self of those who are that, that is, in Me.
44.translation: Thus, even though they did not find him, they did not remember their homes. That is the Self of those who are that, that is, in Me.

45.word_for_word: किन्तु पूर्वं यत्र श्री-कृष्णेन सङ्गतिर् आसीत्, तद् एव कालिन्द्याः पुलिनम् आगत्य कृष्णं भावयन्ति ध्यायन्तीति । — But they come to the bank of the Kalindi River where they used to have association with Lord Kṛṣṇa and meditate on Him.; तथा ताः कृष्णस्यागमनं काङ्क्षितं यासां ताः मिलिताः सत्यः कृष्णम् एव जगुर् इति ॥४५॥ — Thus those women who had longed for the arrival of Krishna together chanted Satya and Krishna alone.
45.translation: But they come to the bank of the Kalindi River where they used to have association with Lord Kṛṣṇa and meditate on Him. Thus those women who had longed for the arrival of Krishna together chanted Satya and Krishna alone.
